title: Classic SEGA-style Sonic sprite (ChatGPT and VEO3)
author: IoncedreamedisuckmyD
selftext:
Maybe I'll actually do something with this since the template for a Sonic game exists and I'm not designing a game from scratch.

Character is mine.

comments.author: nonperverted
comments.body: Pretty need. Would still go over it in photoshop to get those clean pixels

replies.author: captain_ricco1
replies.body: That would be more work than creating the animation from scratch though

replies.author: nonperverted
replies.body: You think tracing over an already complete animation is more work then creating and drawing everything from scratch?

replies.author: captain_ricco1
replies.body: If you were to trace over exactly the same it would be at least the exact same work, right? But you'll need to clean it up at specific places

replies.author: nonperverted
replies.body: I just mean to clean up some of the blurryness with true pixel perfect traceover. Not complicated to do but it goes a long way. Obviously it's will take some effort but if your creating a product, ai will only take you so far when it comes to highest quality output.

comments.author: fantasstic_bet
comments.body: I hope you didn’t use Sonic or SEGA in your prompt

comments.author: captain_ricco1
comments.body: That still has the issue of having wild pixel sizes, it looks kinda pixely, but it would be useless in a proper pixelart game

comments.author: W0mish
comments.body: Is it possible to do something like this with free software?
